scene.note: Each call prints as a line of the log, knows when it is the same call, and sorts by time.

steps.note: A call comes in with its time, its team and what they said.
Printed for people, it is one line of the log.
Shown as Python, as in a list, it is the code that makes it.
Two people type the same call, in different words.
Same time and same team counts as the same call; the words do not matter.
A call is never the same as something that is not a call, and asking does not crash.
The calls arrive in the order they were typed in.
Two calls at a time are asked which came first.
Rhona reads the night in order of time, the earliest first.
Each call is added to the night's log.
Asked how long it is, the log counts its calls.
Asked about a team, the log says whether that team has called tonight.
